cases.translation: The train has arrived, thank God.
cases.explain: Поезд is the grammatical subject of the intransitive verb пришёл (arrived), so it stands in the nominative case.

cases.sentence: Не плачь, говорит мужичок, до ___ заживет.
cases.translation: Don't cry, says the little fellow, it'll heal before the wedding.
cases.explain: The preposition до (until/before) always governs the genitive case, giving свадьбы.

cases.sentence: подвела меня к ___ вот в этой самой комнате в детской.
cases.translation: she led me to the wash-stand right in this very room, in the nursery.
cases.explain: The preposition к (toward) always governs the dative case, giving рукомойнику.

cases.sentence: Так жаль, я обняла ее ___, жала руками и не могу выпустить.
cases.translation: I felt so sorry for her that I embraced her head, pressed it with my hands, and couldn't let go.
cases.explain: Обнять (to embrace) is a transitive verb whose direct object takes the accusative case: голову.

cases.sentence: Входят Дуняша со свечой и Лопахин с ___ в руке.
cases.translation: Dunyasha enters with a candle, and Lopakhin with a book in his hand.
cases.explain: The preposition с (with) expressing accompaniment governs the instrumental case: книгой.

cases.translation: The windows in the room are closed.
cases.explain: The preposition в (in) marking a stationary location takes the prepositional case: комнате.

reading.ru: Пришел поезд, слава богу.
reading.question: What does Lopakhin say has finally happened at the start of the play?
reading.correct: The train has arrived
reading.explain: Lopakhin's opening line announces that the train has finally arrived.

reading.ru: Хороший она человек, легкий, простой человек.
reading.question: How does Lopakhin describe Lyubov Andreevna as he waits for her?
options: As a harsh and demanding woman
As a good, easygoing, simple person
As a stranger he has never met
reading.correct: As a good, easygoing, simple person
reading.explain: Lopakhin recalls her fondly as a good, easy, simple person.

reading.ru: Не плачь, говорит мужичок, до свадьбы заживет.
reading.question: What did young Lyubov Andreevna say to comfort Lopakhin after his father struck him?
options: That she would tell his father off
That it would heal before his wedding (don't cry)
That he should run away from home
That she would bandage the wound herself
reading.correct: That it would heal before his wedding (don't cry)
reading.explain: She tells him not to cry, using the saying 'it will heal before the wedding.'

reading.ru: А собаки всю ночь не спали.
reading.question: According to Dunyasha, what unusual behavior did the dogs show overnight?
options: They ran away from the estate
reading.correct: They didn't sleep all night
reading.explain: Dunyasha says the dogs stayed awake all night because they sense the masters are coming.

reading.ru: Сейчас утренник, мороз в три градуса, а вишня вся в цвету
reading.question: What contrast does Yepikhodov point out about the weather and the cherry orchard?
options: It's a heatwave yet the cherries have already fallen
There's a frost of three degrees yet the cherry trees are all in bloom
It's raining yet the orchard is on fire
It's snowing yet the birds are singing
reading.correct: There's a frost of three degrees yet the cherry trees are all in bloom
reading.explain: Yepikhodov notes the morning frost of three degrees despite the cherry trees being in full bloom.

reading.ru: Каждый день случается со мной какое-нибудь несчастье.
reading.question: What does Yepikhodov say about his daily life?
options: Every day some misfortune happens to him
Every day he receives good news
Every day he plays the guitar for the family
Every day he argues with Lopakhin
reading.correct: Every day some misfortune happens to him
reading.explain: Yepikhodov complains that some misfortune befalls him every single day, earning him the nickname '22 misfortunes.'

reading.ru: А мне, Ермолай Алексеевич, признаться, Епиходов предложение сделал.
reading.question: What news does Dunyasha confide to Lopakhin?
options: That she is leaving the household
That Yepikhodov has proposed marriage to her
That she found a letter from Paris
reading.correct: That Yepikhodov has proposed marriage to her
reading.explain: Dunyasha tells Lopakhin that Yepikhodov has made her a proposal of marriage.

reading.ru: Узнает ли она меня?
reading.question: What does Lopakhin wonder as the carriages approach?
options: Whether Lyubov Andreevna will recognize him after five years
Whether the train is on time
Whether the orchard will be sold
reading.correct: Whether Lyubov Andreevna will recognize him after five years
reading.explain: Lopakhin anxiously wonders if she will recognize him, since they haven't seen each other in five years.

reading.ru: Как холодно, у меня руки закоченели.
reading.question: What does Varya complain about right after arriving?
options: That her hands are frozen from the cold
That the house smells of naphthalene
reading.correct: That her hands are frozen from the cold
reading.explain: Varya remarks how cold it is and that her hands have gone numb.

reading.ru: Поезд опоздал на два часа.
reading.question: What does Gaev complain about as the family arrives?
options: That the train was two hours late
That the servants forgot the luggage
That Firs is too old to work
That the orchard has been sold
reading.correct: That the train was two hours late
reading.explain: Gaev exclaims that the train was two hours late, questioning what kind of arrangements these are.

reading.ru: Третьего дня Петр Сергеевич приехали.
reading.question: What does Dunyasha tell Anya about Petya Trofimov?
options: He arrived two days ago and is staying in the bathhouse
He has already left for Paris
He refused to visit the estate
reading.correct: He arrived two days ago and is staying in the bathhouse
reading.explain: Dunyasha tells Anya that Pyotr Sergeyevich (Trofimov) arrived two days ago and lives in the bathhouse.

reading.ru: Дуняша, кофе поскорей.
reading.question: What is the first thing Varya asks for when she enters?
reading.correct: Coffee, quickly
reading.explain: Varya immediately instructs Dunyasha to bring coffee quickly since her mother wants it.

reading.ru: Дачу свою около Ментоны она уже продала.
reading.question: What financial detail does Anya reveal about her mother?
options: She has already sold her dacha near Menton
She won a lottery in Paris
She bought a new estate in Yalta
She invested all her money in the railway
reading.correct: She has already sold her dacha near Menton
reading.explain: Anya tells Varya that their mother has already sold her villa near Menton and now has nothing left.

reading.ru: Варя, в августе будут продавать имение.
reading.question: What does Varya reveal will happen in August?
options: The family will move to Paris
reading.correct: The estate will be sold
reading.explain: Varya tells Anya that the estate will be sold in August, prompting Anya's distress.

reading.ru: Птицы поют в саду, который теперь час.
reading.question: What does Anya notice while standing near her room?
options: That birds are singing in the orchard
That the house is completely silent
That it has started to rain
That Lopakhin is arguing with Gaev
reading.correct: That birds are singing in the orchard
reading.explain: Anya remarks that birds are singing in the garden and asks what time it is.

reading.ru: Шесть лет тому назад умер отец.
reading.question: What tragedy does Anya recall from six years ago?
options: The loss of the family estate
reading.correct: Her father's death
reading.explain: Anya recalls that their father died six years ago.

reading.ru: Через месяц утонул в реке брат Гриша.
reading.question: What happened to Anya's brother Grisha a month after their father's death?
reading.correct: He drowned in the river
reading.explain: Anya recounts that a month later, her little brother Grisha drowned in the river.

reading.ru: Мне сейчас в пятом часу утра в Харьков ехать.
reading.question: Why does Lopakhin say he must leave soon?
options: He has to travel to Kharkov at five in the morning
He is meeting a buyer for the orchard
He must catch a train to Paris
He needs to visit his sick father
reading.correct: He has to travel to Kharkov at five in the morning
reading.explain: Lopakhin explains that he must leave for Kharkov at five o'clock in the morning.

reading.ru: Вам уже известно, вишневый сад ваш продается за долги.
reading.question: What news does Lopakhin deliver about the cherry orchard?
options: It is being sold for debts
It has been donated to the town
reading.correct: It is being sold for debts
reading.explain: Lopakhin informs the family that their cherry orchard is being sold to cover their debts.

reading.ru: Вырубить старый вишневый сад.
reading.question: What drastic solution does Lopakhin propose for saving the estate?
options: Cutting down the old cherry orchard to build dachas
Marrying Anya to a rich man
reading.correct: Cutting down the old cherry orchard to build dachas
reading.explain: Lopakhin proposes clearing away old buildings and cutting down the old cherry orchard to make room for dacha plots.

reading.ru: В прежнее время, лет сорок-пятьдесят назад, вишню сушили, мочили, мариновали, варенье варили и бывало...
reading.question: What does old Firs recall about the cherry orchard's past?
options: That forty or fifty years ago the cherries were dried, soaked, pickled, and made into jam
That the orchard used to be much smaller
That the cherries were once poisonous
That no one ever harvested the cherries before
reading.correct: That forty or fifty years ago the cherries were dried, soaked, pickled, and made into jam
reading.explain: Firs reminisces that forty or fifty years ago cherries were dried, soaked, pickled, and turned into jam.

reading.ru: Шкаф сделан ровно сто лет тому назад.
reading.question: What does Gaev discover about the old bookcase?
options: It was made exactly a hundred years ago
It was a gift from his grandfather
It was recently repaired by Yasha
reading.correct: It was made exactly a hundred years ago
reading.explain: Gaev announces that the bookcase was made exactly one hundred years ago, based on numbers he found burned into a drawer.

reading.ru: Через три недели увидимся.
reading.question: When does Lopakhin say he will see the family again before leaving?
reading.correct: In three weeks
reading.explain: As he departs, Lopakhin says they will see each other again in three weeks.

reading.ru: Мне приказано было ждать до утра, но у меня не хватило терпения.
reading.question: Why does Trofimov say he came to see Lyubov Andreevna at night instead of waiting?
options: He was told to wait until morning but couldn't be patient
He was afraid of missing the train
reading.correct: He was told to wait until morning but couldn't be patient
reading.explain: Trofimov explains he was told to wait until morning but didn't have the patience to do so.

reading.ru: Солнышко мое, весна моя.
reading.question: How does Trofimov describe Anya at the very end of the scene?
options: As the true heir of the estate
reading.correct: As his sunshine, his spring
reading.explain: In the closing line, Trofimov tenderly calls Anya his sunshine, his spring.
